note: Known page-structure divergences between the iOS contract and the Android screens. This ratchet only shrinks: fix one, delete its row. Regenerate with --write-baseline only when the change is reviewed as a ratchet move.

divergences.name: 保存修改并重连
divergences.reason: The extractor now reads this control's label (`MCPSettingsPage.swift:245`: `Text(existing == nil ? "保存并连接" : "保存修改并重连")`): the steady wording `保存修改并重连` is the label, `保存并连接` its `labelAlternatives`, and the checker satisfies the action with either. Android renders a third wording: `MCPEditorPage.kt:874` labels the save action `UiStrings.MCP_SAVE` = `保存` in both the add and the edit case, and `MCPEditorPage.kt:15-17` records that choice. Under README §1 (iOS is the baseline) the phone copy should be state-specific, so the finding is real — one control whose copy was shortened, which is why it is one row and not a missing/extra pair (the checker pairs the two directions when the Android label is a shortened copy of a contract wording). The fix is one expression in `android/lib/.../page/MCPEditorPage.kt`: label the action `保存并连接` when `facts.server == null`, else `保存修改并重连`. That file belongs to another lane; this lane may not edit it. This row used to read `extra-action 保存`: the same defect seen from the far side while the label was invisible to the extractor.
